"""Run the unchanged write harness; retain its finished 1M store after timing."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

from benchmarks import next_generation_storage as benchmark
from commontrace import fact_store

original_measure = benchmark.measure

def measure_and_retain(root, size, trials):
    measured = original_measure(root, size, trials)
    if size == 1_000_000:
        # The API operations and every timing have finished before this copy.
        fact_store.close_connections(root)
        parent = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='commontrace-p0-retained-million-')
        destination = os.path.join(parent, 'sqlite')
        shutil.copytree(root, destination)
        metadata = {'root': destination, 'source_root': root,
                    'wrapper_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                    'retention': 'Only after all original measurement samples; no write settings changed'}
        Path('/tmp/commontrace-p0-retained-million-store.json').write_text(json.dumps(metadata, indent=2)+'\n')
        print('Retained completed million-fact store:', destination, flush=True)
    return measured

benchmark.measure = measure_and_retain
raise SystemExit(benchmark.main())
retention: The unchanged benchmark.measure finishes every timing before idle handles are closed and its finished 1M store is copied. Original temporary-store cleanup still runs.
